meta.about: Every new string of the set-up flow, the four-gun HUD and the new guns, attachments, crew and levels (docs/unreal/LOADOUT.md 2.12). Keyed as it will sit in text.json under `frontend`; kept in its own file because text.json is written by tools/ue-export from the web game and a hand edit there would be overwritten. The loader reads both; a key of this file never shadows a key of text.json.
meta.encoding: a string with {name} parameters is a template, written as in text.json: {"$template": {template, params, example}}
meta.voice: the game's own: short, street, second person, no real makes or models, no real people other than the star

example.value: RULE · CHOPPER / NINE · The Block · Story · Boss

home.firstTime: First time out: Rule, the CHOPPER and the NINE.

crew.title: Pick your crew
crew.note: Looks only. Everybody shoots the same.

rule.name: RULE
rule.tagline: The star. Leather gloves, steel watch, curb chain.

deuce.name: DEUCE
deuce.tagline: Drives the getaway. Fingerless knits, hoodie pushed up, gold rope.

smoke.name: SMOKE
smoke.tagline: Says nothing. Bare hands, taped knuckles, black bomber.

keys.name: KEYS
keys.tagline: Runs the board at the Vault. Cut-finger wool, denim cuff, digital watch.

loadout.title: Pick your four
loadout.carry: Carry up to four. Melee comes with you.
loadout.emptyHint: Pick a gun from the rack
loadout.full: All four slots are full: pick a slot to swap out

attachments.factoryNote: What it came with. No change.

irons.name: Folding irons
irons.blurb: Flip-up sights. Fold down under a scope.

scope.name: Scope
scope.blurb: Reach across the block. Slow to come up.

silencer.name: Silencer
silencer.blurb: Keeps it quiet. Loses a little bite at range.

gripVertical.name: Vertical grip
gripVertical.blurb: Holds the muzzle down. Heavier in the hands.

gripAngled.name: Angled grip
gripAngled.blurb: Quick to the eye. Wanders more sideways.

laser.name: Laser
laser.blurb: Tightens hip fire. The dot shows where it goes.

magClear.name: Clear mag
magClear.blurb: See what's left. Lighter, so it kicks a touch more.

hgShort.name: Short handguard
hgShort.blurb: Fast in tight spaces. Loud, kicky, worse at range.

hgExtended.name: Long handguard
hgExtended.blurb: Steady and accurate. Slow around corners.

effects.about: One line per effect, built from the data: {sign} is + or −, {pct} the whole-number percentage change of the stat, {value} the new value. Shown green when better, red when worse (the stat's `better` in attachments.json).

block.name: The Block
block.blurb: Jamaica Ave under the El. The avenue, the chop shop, the cage, the lot.

formats.score: rounded to a whole number, en-US digit grouping (12,345)

difficultyNotes.hustler: Vultures go down easier and you heal faster.
difficultyNotes.boss: The block as it was meant to be played.
difficultyNotes.kingpin: More of them, harder hitting, slow to heal.

stick.name: STICK
stick.blurb: Rail carbine, 30 rounds. Build it any way you want.

rattler.name: RATTLER
rattler.blurb: Taken off a Vulture. 32 rounds, quick hands, short reach.
